That night, for the first time in years, he wrote a letter — addressed to no one, sealed in a bottle of his own.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市褪去白昼的喧嚣，陷入一种暧昧的寂静。路灯仍亮着，橘黄的光洒在空无一人的街道上，像是给沥青铺了一层薄霜。远处，二十四小时便利店的灯牌孤独地闪烁，店员倚在柜台后半梦半醒。一辆洒水车缓缓驶过，留下湿漉漉的轨迹和淡淡的水腥气。几只流浪猫从巷口探出头，试探着走向尚有余温的排风口。环卫工人的扫帚声由远及近，像城市最低沉的心跳。天际线还没有泛白，但早点铺的蒸笼已经升起第一缕热气，宣告新的一天正悄然来临。", "w03": "• Recursion is when a function calls itself to solve a problem — imagine looking at two mirrors facing each other, where each reflection contains another reflection inside it.\n• Each time the function calls itself, it works on a smaller, simpler version of the problem — like if I asked you to count stairs, you could say \"it's one stair plus however many stairs are left,\" and keep doing that until there are zero stairs left.\n• You always need a \"stopping rule\" (called a base case) so the function knows when to quit — otherwise it would keep calling itself forever, like saying \"are we there yet?\" for eternity."}
